Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original full-body intro action sprite for the existing Digital Circus Encore game.

Reference image 1 is the accepted cafepomni selection: lock its identity, proportions, line weight, cel shading, costume construction and colors. Reference image 2 is the official Animate Cafe illustration detail: preserve its distinctive outfit. Make a genuinely new intro pose, not a flipped or mechanically moved copy. Only one character.

Pomni keeps her white face, brown bob, red/blue pinwheel irises, red cheeks, complete red/dark-navy two-point jester hat with TWO YELLOW bells, white frilled headband and navy bows. Short dark navy puff-sleeved dress, white ruffled bib/apron, BLUE bow at anatomical right and RED bow at anatomical left, white gloves and scalloped cuffs, two slender WHITE legs, white scalloped ankle cuffs. Right anatomical shoe is RED and left anatomical shoe is DARK NAVY with white accents. Preserve the neck bow shown in the accepted selection. Do not swap the shoes or apron bows, darken the legs, introduce yellow ankle cuffs or convert the hat to white pompoms.

POSE: Entrance greeting: a small shy forward bow toward screen-right, one white-gloved hand over the chest and the other gently extended in welcome. Both feet grounded, complete dress and apron visible. Keep a cautious friendly smile and the full two-point hat.

Native orientation is SCREEN-RIGHT. Keep all visible costume asymmetry consistent with the selection. Crisp dark contours and restrained flat two-tone cel shading, same polished 2D game family. Center the complete silhouette with generous transparent space around every extremity; use a wider composition if needed so nothing touches the edges. Native transparent RGBA. No scenery, floor, cast shadow, halo, bloom, sticker outline, motion streaks, text, logo, watermark, duplicate figure or additional limbs. Preserve all original image pixels in the delivered native result; no painted checkerboard or solid background.
